definitions: The act or process of adding things together; a total or aggregate.
A final review or summary of the main points of an argument or case, especially in a legal context.
The process by which the effects of a number of stimuli are added together to produce a larger effect.
examples: The summation of all the figures gave us the grand total.
The lawyer's summation was very persuasive.
Neural summation is crucial for signal processing.
